meta.title: SalePage — Launch your online store in 30 seconds | salepage.in.th
meta.description: Ready-made e-commerce platform for Thai sellers. Direct PromptPay payments, AI slip verification, no code required — free forever.
meta.ogTitle: SalePage — Launch your online store in 30 seconds
meta.ogDescription: Create an online store free. Get paid directly via PromptPay with built-in AI slip verification.

hero.badge: Open in 30 seconds — 2× faster than any competitor
hero.desc: Ready-made store platform — just enter your phone and you get <qr>an automatic PromptPay QR</qr>, plus our <ai>AI slip verifier</ai>. Your customer transfers, you verify, you ship — all in 1 minute.
hero.tickerHeading: Real orders happening across our network

promptpay.title2: in a fraction of a second
promptpay.desc: QR generated to the Bank of Thailand spec. Your customers scan with any bank app.
promptpay.qrEmpty: Enter a PromptPay ID to generate a QR
promptpay.footer: Generated real-time by our API · try it for real

errors.invalidId: Enter a 10-digit phone or 13-digit national ID

features.desc: Every feature an online shop needs — redesigned to be faster, prettier, and easier.

speed.title: 30-second setup
speed.desc: 3 steps and you're selling — no code, no design, the system styles it for you.

qr.title: Automatic PromptPay QR
qr.desc: Enter your phone or national ID; we generate a QR with the right amount instantly.

ai.title: AI slip verification
ai.desc: Customers upload a slip — we check amount, recipient, and time in under 2 seconds.

fees.title: No fees, no skim
fees.desc: Money flows directly from your customer's account to yours — SalePage is never a money intermediary.

link.title: One link, sell everywhere
link.desc: salepage.in.th/{your-shop} pasted on IG, TikTok, LINE OA, FB — sells anywhere.

admin.title: Pro back-office
admin.desc: Orders, stock, coupons, reviews, dashboard — everything a serious shop needs.

mobile.title: Web + mobile app
mobile.desc: API-first. Run your shop from web or a native mobile app — real-time sync.

theme.title: Pro-grade themes
theme.desc: Big-brand level design. Tweak colors / logo / banner — or pick a preset.

performance.title: Fast every page, every time
performance.desc: < 1s page loads, instant orders, real-time slip alerts — no waiting.

preview.title: A beautiful storefront from order #1
preview.desc: A real example shop — tap the card to open the full storefront.

pricing.title1: Pay only for what you use —
pricing.desc: Free forever. No per-order fee. Customers transfer money straight to your account.
